notes.title: The Frogs Demo Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40227493/e5c53d6f3ac2d438440bfa208bcf3e593fe54980.pngHello! I've just pushed through an update with extensive testing which means there will be plenty of bugs and typos for you all to find, I'm sure. Here's what's new!

- Menus got a bit of an overhaul. They look better and, hopefully, work better.
- Added an Options menu with a music volume slider and subtitle size option.
- Inventory window now closes when you select an item.
- You can left and right click on items in your inventory to examine them.
- Dialogue in various spots has been cleaned up a bit.
- Fixed some weirdness in how a few interactions worked.
- Various typos and mistargeted dialogue have been cleaned up.

I hope you enjoy, and please don't hesitate to reach out if you have issues! I can be slow to respond sometimes, but I really do appreciate it!
